note: Open facet table. Patterns run over card, summary, signature, program and scope text; a rule that matches nothing keeps tag 'other' so coverage stays visible.

redundant-operand-loads.meaning: The same input bytes are loaded or decoded more than once.

materialised-intermediate.meaning: A temporary is written to memory only to be read back.

extra-pass.meaning: A pass exists only to collect a statistic or result for a later pass.

numeric-range-or-precision.meaning: Values overflow, underflow or lose accuracy in the working format.

scalar-work-where-instruction-exists.meaning: Scalar loops do what a matrix or vector instruction could.

shared-memory-capacity.meaning: Staged data does not fit shared memory or tensor memory.

register-pressure.meaning: Live values exceed the register budget.

load-imbalance-or-idle-units.meaning: Some executors idle while others carry the work.

contention-on-shared-state.meaning: Many workers contend for the same lock, atomic or bank.

synchronisation-stall.meaning: Workers wait on barriers or completions more than they compute.

transfer-blocks-compute.meaning: Copies do not overlap with computation.

padded-or-empty-work.meaning: Tiles, tails or rows do no useful work yet still cost time.

irregular-or-indirect-access.meaning: Data reached through indices, pages or sparse structure.

layout-mismatch.meaning: Stored layout does not match the consumer order.

decode-overhead.meaning: Encoded or quantized values cost time to expand.

repeated-launch-or-setup-cost.meaning: Setup, launch or descriptor work dominates small problems.

expensive-math-function.meaning: An exp, log or other costly function dominates.

global-memory.meaning: DRAM or global bytes and bandwidth.

special-function-units.meaning: SFU operations such as exp and log.

dma-and-async-copy.meaning: Async copy, TMA and DMA engines.

cta-occupancy.meaning: CTA slots, grid size and launches.

interconnect.meaning: Peer links, networks and multi-device transport.
